newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK IMOP HOLDS SESSION ON GREEK ECONOMY.
newsitem.headline: GREEK IMOP HOLDS SESSION ON GREEK ECONOMY.

text.p: The Athens Institute of Economic Policy Studies (IMOP) will hold a session on "Economic Development: The Hellenic Experience" and present its first book on Tuesday, October 22, at 1900 local at the Foreign Press Association.
Economics professors George Alogoskoufis, Tryfon Kollintzas, Luca Katseli and Deputy Finance Minister Nickos Chrystodoulakis who contributed to the book will be the key note speakers at the meeting.
The book titled "Studies of Economic Policy" contains research articles written by leading Greek economics professors on modern economic development theories and their application to Greece.
IMPO will similar books twice a year in January and June. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
